show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Karl Scheer – Competing Sensibly as CIO of the University of Cincinnati (EP.74)
summary:
Before taking the helm
at Cincinnati in 2011, he co-ran a family office and spent eight
years in the venture capital industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors.
